item.title: MAC FM · Saturday 3 October 2026
item.description:
MAC Fellas, good morning. Flydubai Cargo just launched its first scheduled B737-800 freighter network. Three dedicated narrowbodies are hitting the skies. That’s significant. It adds new regional capacity that might compete for e-commerce flows previously reliant on belly space. It’s a shift in how we view narrowbody freight. Exactly. And while we watch that, e-commerce growth is intensifying scrutiny on lithium battery safety. Stricter regulatory reviews are coming for these shipments. Right. Increased compliance could impact handling procedures and operational efficiency for carriers moving high-volume consumer electronics. Stay sharp on those safety protocols.
